output.summary: Group ticket time rose about 4 minutes at all nine locations in October 2024. This is the Made Here scratch menu, whose cost the board projected and accepted in August 2024 with a 19-minute ceiling and about 15% price rises. Since then satisfaction, check size and same-store sales have all improved. The 12-minute benchmark panel excludes scratch kitchens, so the comparison is invalid. Riverside's decline began in August 2026. It follows the saute/pasta cook's departure, an unfilled position, and group operations deferring transfer requests. KDS timings show the delay at the saute/pasta station. Reasons for the cook leaving are conflicting and unconfirmed. Hours cuts hit all four line cooks and followed lower Sunday covers. Firing the GM and the group-wide frozen conversion and bonus target are unjustified. Restore Riverside staffing and reset the benchmark.
